title: Deep eutectic solvents as recyclable media for metal removal from crude oil
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,16211-16219
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09189F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Eminemi Mirinn, Andrew P. Abbott, Alexander F. R. Kilpatrick
Acidified deep eutectic solvents (DES) extract metalloporphyrins from crude oil via protonation-driven transfer into a DES phase enabling efficient, low-energy, metal removal with simple separation and reuse.
